title: Restriction of a descent datum to a saturated open
statement: Let $p:A\to B$ be a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] morphism of finite presentation between affine schemes [def-pc-scheme]; finite presentation means locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\pi:V\to A$ be a scheme over $A$ with a descent datum $\phi:V\times_B A\xrightarrow{\sim}A\times_B V$ satisfying the cocycle $\phi_{02}=\phi_{12}\circ\phi_{01}$ [def-pd-descent-datum, def-pc-fibre-product]. For an affine open subscheme $C\subset V$ [def-weil-open-immersion], define $r_C:C\times_B A\to V$ as the inclusion into $V\times_B A$, followed by $\phi$ and the projection to $V$, and put $W_C=\operatorname{im}(|r_C|)\subset |V|$. Suppose $W_C$ is open and give it its open subscheme structure. Then $\phi$ restricts to an isomorphism $\phi_C:W_C\times_B A\xrightarrow{\sim}A\times_B W_C$ over $A\times_B A$ satisfying the same cocycle. Here, for a test scheme $Z$, maps $a,b:Z\to A$ with $p\circ a=p\circ b$ and $z:Z\to V$ with $\pi\circ z=a$, the *transport of $z$ from $a$ to $b$* for $\phi$ is the $V$-component of $\phi\circ(z,b):Z\to A\times_BV$; it lies over $b$. Transport for $\phi_C$ is defined in the same way. Moreover, for every test scheme $Z$, maps $a,b:Z\to A$ with $p\circ a=p\circ b$, and $v:Z\to W_C$ with $\pi\circ\iota_C\circ v=a$, transport from $a$ to $b$ for $\phi_C$, followed by the inclusion $\iota_C:W_C\hookrightarrow V$, equals transport of $\iota_C\circ v$ for $\phi$. No separatedness, local quasi-finiteness or quasi-compactness hypothesis on $V\to A$ is imposed. All schemes lie in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Tag 02W8, lemma-separated-locally-quasi-finite-morphisms-fppf-descend, second paragraph, the equality phi(W times A) = A times W and the restricted descent datum (old step 4)

proof.text: Put R = V ×_B A, s = pullback.fst and t = D.toHom. The universal transport D.univ of the proved source-library invariant-open API is definitionally D.toHom. The cartesian square and universal point are those of def-pc-fibre-product and def-pd-descent-datum.

Let m be the map C ×_B A → R induced by C.ι, id_A and id_B. Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.range_map, the chosen-pullback form of base-change image, gives range(m) = s⁻¹(C), since the second factor map is the identity. Taking the range of m ≫ t yields W = t(s⁻¹(C)).

For r with s(r) in W choose r₀ with s(r₀) in C and t(r₀)=s(r). Apply descent_orbit_saturated at c=s(r₀): r belongs to s⁻¹(O_c), hence to t⁻¹(O_c). Choose r₁ with s(r₁)=c and t(r₁)=t(r). Since c is in C, this witnesses t(r) in W. By the proved source-library isInvariant_iff this pointwise property is D.IsInvariant W. This is exactly the orbit-union argument, without assuming a common residue field.

Use the already proved source-library construction D.restrict W hInv (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveDescent.Invariant). Its restrictTransport factors each transported map through W.ι using IsOpenImmersion.lift. Its naturality, identity and cocycle proofs cancel W.ι, an open-immersion monomorphism. Thus it realizes the restriction and cocycle directly in transport form, without constructing a second pullback isomorphism.

Choose E = D.restrict W hInv. The proved restrict_transport_left_ι lemma gives exactly the required equality for every Z,a,b,h,v; its Over.homMk (v.left ≫ W.ι) is definitionally v ≫ Over.homMk W.ι rfl.

It is a split with no new nodes, and the item is still unsplit in live and side-live, so no other group has superseded it. Compared with side-live, the statement, stmt_deps and blueprint fields are unchanged; only the proof, proof_deps, proof_origin, searches, split_report and status changed. The source, Stacks 02W8 (more-morphisms.tex, second paragraph), says the restriction holds 'by the cocycle condition', and the delivery writes that argument out. Step 1: the transport form t∘(z,b) of φ follows from def-pd-descent-datum, and the cocycle on the diagonal gives D_aa=1; this is elementary. Step 2: C×_B A is the pullback of R along C↪V, and lem-weil-pbc-base-change-image (image_preimage_eq_of_isPullback) gives image s⁻¹|C|, so W_C is the union of the orbits O_c. Step 3: lem-pd-descent-orbit-saturated, whose only hypotheses are a scheme map and a transport datum, gives s⁻¹O_c=t⁻¹O_c, and the union is then invariant; there is no cycle. Step 4: j_0 and j_1 are open immersions with images s⁻¹W and pr_V⁻¹W, φ and φ⁻¹ preserve these by step 3, and the factorization goes through IsOpenImmersion.lift, so it does not factor through a bare image. Step 5: cancelling the monomorphisms gives the inverse, composing with (v,b) gives the transport clause, and the cocycle follows through the universal point. Edge cases checked: C empty, p the identity, and a datum swapping two copies of A. A duplicate search for invariant/saturated descent data found only finite-p pd nodes, the consumer lem-pd-effective-invariant-open-cover, and lem-trf-invariant-open-image-pullback, which descends an already-invariant open; none duplicates the item. I accept the declared tool use of lem-pd-descent-orbit-saturated (unit sk-prop-jacobian-descent) as a generic black box. The searches include all three kinds, and no SGA source is cited. Maintainer note: lem-pd-descent-orbit-saturated cites Tag 0H8K where Tag 0APF is meant; that is the other node's fault and not used here.

lean.statement: theorem exists_descentDatum_saturation_open {A B : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine A] [IsAffine B] (p : A ⟶ B) [Flat p] [Surjective p] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation p] [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p] {V : Over A} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V) (C : V.left.Opens) (_hC : IsAffineOpen C) (W : V.left.Opens) (_hW : (W : Set V.left) = Set.range (pullback.map (C.ι ≫ V.hom ≫ p) p (V.hom ≫ p) p C.ι (𝟙 A) (𝟙 B) (by simp) (by simp) ≫ D.toHom)) : ∃ E : Over.DescentDatum p (Over.mk (W.ι ≫ V.hom)), ∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (a b : Z ⟶ A) (h : a ≫ p = b ≫ p) (v : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk (W.ι ≫ V.hom)), (E.transport a b h v).left ≫ W.ι = (D.transport a b h (v ≫ Over.homMk W.ι rfl)).left

reviewed_lean.note: Every hypothesis and conclusion clause of lem-trf-descent-saturation-invariant-open matches the Lean: affine A,B; Flat/Surjective/LocallyOfFinitePresentation/QuasiCompact/QuasiSeparated p; V : Over A with the recorded Over.DescentDatum D; affine open C; W pinned to Set.range (pullback.map (C.ι ≫ V.hom ≫ p) p … ≫ D.toHom), where toHom is the V-component of φ on V ×_B A; conclusion ∃ E : DescentDatum on W.ι ≫ V.hom with (E.transport v).left ≫ W.ι = (D.transport (v ≫ homMk W.ι)).left for all Z,a,b, which pins E because W.ι is mono. Nothing is assumed about V → A, and one universe u covers all schemes. Edge cases (C/V/A empty, p = id, swap datum, non-closed points, non-reduced Z) are fine. Docstrings carry source place, blueprint id and the five proof steps; no line exceeds 100 chars; proof is sorry only; no new nodes.
